units.source_text: 住持田山道诠和尚与父亲是禅堂的学友。

en.t: The abbot, Reverend Tayama Dosen, and my father were fellow students in the Zen hall.

units.source_text: 道诠和尚与父亲共同度过三年的禅堂生活，

en.t: Reverend Dosen and my father spent three years of Zen-hall life together,
and during that time they ate and lived together,

units.source_text: 两人都在据说是义满将军建立的相国寺专门道场修行，

en.t: both training at the specialized dojo of Shokokuji, which was said to have been founded by Shogun Yoshimitsu,

units.source_text: 经过自古以来形成的终日垂头和三日坐样的仪式，

en.t: and after undergoing the rites formed since ancient times, such as bowing their heads all day and sitting in meditation for three days,

units.source_text: 然后才成为相国寺派的成员。

en.t: only then did they become members of the Shokokuji school.
Nor was that all; even later,

units.source_text: 道诠法师兴致上来的时候还曾谈及他同父亲不仅是如此辛苦修行的学友，

en.t: when Priest Dosen was in the mood, he would say that he and my father had been not only fellow students in such arduous training,
but also companions in visiting prostitutes,

units.source_text: 他们在就寝时间之后，时常翻越土墙，

en.t: and that after bedtime they would often climb over the earthen wall,
go out to buy women, and amuse themselves in pleasure.
